name: Wireframe Sphere Background
description: A three.js wireframe sphere background for React: a dense mesh pushed in and out by flowing Perlin noise, lit as a rainbow heat map where it bulges, seen through a pincushion lens that folds it into rings and petals with a moiré shimmer. Drag to turn it; every setting is live; pauses off screen.

props.name: detail
props.description: Wireframe segments around and down the sphere (rebuilds the mesh).

props.name: noiseScale
props.description: How fine the noise that shapes the surface is.

props.name: noiseIntensity
props.description: How far the noise pushes the surface in and out.

props.name: colorIntensity
props.description: How strongly the bulges light up in the heat-map colours.

props.name: baseColor
props.description: Colour the hollows fade to, and the solid core.

props.name: solidCore
props.description: A solid core that hides the far side of the wireframe.

props.name: distortion
props.description: Lens: negative folds the picture inward (pincushion), positive bulges it, 0 is off.

props.name: aberration
props.description: Splits the lens into red, green and blue fringes.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the wrapper. It fills its parent, so give the parent a height.
